_comment: Mutation testing over the pure-logic modules. The unit tier reports 100% line, branch, function and statement coverage on src/lib — a statement that every branch was *executed*, not that a test would fail if one were wrong. This measures the second thing. See Guiding Rule 4 in TEST_STRATEGY.md.
_comment_mutate: Deliberately the same surface as the coverage config in vite.config.ts, minus its two exclusions: api.ts is the I/O boundary that a unit test cannot even import, and devTools.ts is a single import.meta.env constant. Mutating either would manufacture survivors that say nothing about the unit tier, and the two numbers would stop describing the same code.
_comment_coverageAnalysis: perTest: Stryker runs only the tests that actually cover each mutant. The unit suite is ~300ms with no I/O and no shared state, so this is safe here and cuts the run substantially.
_comment_thresholds: No CI gate, on purpose. Do not set a threshold before there is a measured baseline to set it from — a number picked in advance is either so low it passes anything or so high it blocks the first honest run. `break` is null so the command reports and never fails the build.
